reason: Yahweh's anger in this passage is directed at Pharaoh and Egypt because they refuse to allow the Israelites to worship and serve Him properly (עבדו את־יהוה). The entire sequence of the final plague is a response to the blocking of proper worship—Pharaoh's hardened heart has repeatedly prevented Israel from going to serve Yahweh as commanded. The tenth plague constitutes Yahweh's judgment against those who obstruct proper worship of Him.
